subject.title: feat(android): platform trust for public gateway certs + manual fingerprint pinning

question: Should eligible public DNS gateway endpoints be allowed to replace mandatory leaf-fingerprint pinning with Android platform certificate-and-hostname validation, while preserving explicit pins until a user opts out?
rationale: This is an intentional authentication-policy change rather than a mechanical defect fix; automated review cannot choose the repository's acceptable trust model for existing Android gateway users.

options.title: Accept platform trust with field proof
options.body: Confirm the public-certificate trust model and require redacted real-device evidence for public trust, pin preservation, and manual-pin recovery before merge.

options.title: Keep fingerprint-only trust
options.body: Retain the existing pinning model for all gateway hosts and close or narrow the public-certificate trust portion of the change.

recommendation.title: Accept platform trust with field proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the public-certificate trust model and require redacted real-device evidence for public trust, pin preservation, and manual-pin recovery before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author supplied the detailed Android TLS policy and is the clearest available routing contact for the proposed trust-model decision.
